opis: The sunny brook from the reference picture (the same clear water, round mossy boulders and the little wooden footbridge far on the right). In the middle of the water floats a small flat wooden RAFT of six logs tied with rope, lying perfectly LEVEL and steady on the water. In the MIDDLE of the raft sits the big BEAR, and next to him in the middle a whole green striped WATERMELON and a silver cooking POT with a lid; at the LEFT edge of the raft lies a folded red-and-white checked picnic BLANKET, at the RIGHT edge the BUNNY sits holding the string of one red BALLOON floating above. At the back of the raft the BEAVER steers it with a long wooden pole, proud. On the far bank ahead, green grass with a few flowers waits for the picnic. Calm, happy and sunny, little ripples round the raft.
